result:
Each query is written from the page alone and none was run. Three points rest on guesses:
- `groupBy ~/0` in M13 assumes `groupBy` accepts a quoted key.
- `groupBy * count` in M3 and M5 is copied from the page's example and groups by the element itself.
- M14 has no regex, so it splits on spaces, then on `.` and `;`, which covers this particular text.

M1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) * (/email | lower) | sort
M2: * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | [sum count] | div /0 /1 | mul 10 | round | div 10
M3: / * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country) | filter ~(type | eq ::string) * upper | groupBy * count
M4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels * lower | contains "bug") | sort ~([(/priority | mul -1) /id]) * /id | take 2
M5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (at :assignee | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy * count
M6: / * /labels | flat * lower | distinct | sort
M7: /dependencies | :d / | keys * (:k / | {:name (k | keyword) :version (d | at k | if (startsWith "^") ~(drop 1) ~(/) | if (startsWith "~") ~(drop 1) ~(/))}) | sort ~/name
M8: filter ~(:o / | #["paid" "shipped"] | contains (o | /status)) * /items | flat * (mul /qty /price) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
M9: filter ~(/status | ne "cancelled") | :os / * /customer | distinct * (:c / | {:customer c :total (os | filter ~(/customer | eq c) * /items | flat * (mul /qty /price) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100)}) | sort ~([(/total | mul -1) /customer]) | take 2
M10: /services | filter ~(at :tls | coalesce {} | at :enabled | eq true) | :sv / | keys | sort * (:k / | sv | at k | [/host (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join ":")
M11: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") * /2 | groupBy * count
M12: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~(:p / | #["WARN" "ERROR"] | contains (p | /1)) | filter ~(drop 3 | join " " | lower | contains "timeout") * /2 | distinct | sort
M13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~/0 * (/ * (/2 | parseJson) | [sum count] | div /0 /1 | round)
M14: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." | split " " * (split ".") | flat * (split ";") | flat * lower | filter ~(count | gt 0) | :w / | distinct * (:x / | {:word x :count (w | filter ~(eq x) | count)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word]) | take 3
